Name: Phone Online Service
Author: inetyoumc
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=6][b]Phone Online Service[/b][/size]
[size=4][i]Order from the shops by phone. Pay the courier. Get it delivered to your farmhouse.[/i][/size]

[line]

[size=5][b]ENGLISH + 简体中文 · FULL DUAL-LANGUAGE MOD[/b][/size]

[b]Every single line of text in this mod ships in both English and Simplified Chinese, and switches automatically with your game language. No language pack, no config, no patching.[/b]

[b]本模组全部文本均提供完整英文与简体中文版本——电话菜单、商店按钮、提示信息、报错文案，一个不落，随游戏语言自动切换，不需要额外安装语言包或做任何设置。[/b]

[quote][b]中文玩家请注意 / For Chinese players:[/b] 只要你的游戏语言是简体中文，装好之后电话里出现的“在线下单”“预约房屋升级”“在线工具升级”等全部条目都是中文，弹出的送达提示也是中文。游戏语言是英文时，整页自动变成英文。[/quote]
[line]

[size=5][b]MAIN FEATURES[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]Order from 7 shops by phone[/b] — Pierre, Robin, Marnie, Clint, Sandy, Willy, Gus.[/*]
[*][b]10–20% delivery fee[/b] (default 15%), already included in the price shown in the shop menu.[/*]
[*][b]Delayed delivery[/b] — 10–20 in-game minutes (default 15); the goods arrive as a gift-box package on your farmhouse floor.[/*]
[*][b]Online tool upgrades[/b] — Clint upgrades a tool from your bag and sends it back as a package.[/*]
[*][b]Online geode cracking[/b] — 25g per geode, the loot is delivered to your door.[/*]
[*][b]Online house upgrades[/b] — book Robin's next upgrade; normal three-day build, normal gold and materials.[/*]
[*][b]Vanilla UI only[/b] — the real shop menu and real dialogue boxes, no custom menus or sprites.[/*]
[*][b]Nothing can be lost[/b] — farmhouse floor full, then the mailbox, then straight into your inventory.[/*]
[*][b]Fully localised[/b] — English and Simplified Chinese, follows the game language.[/*]
[*][b]Two console commands[/b] — pos_status and pos_deliver for troubleshooting.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b]HOW IT WORKS[/b][/size]

In vanilla the telephone only rings one way: NPCs call you, you can call back, and that is the end of it. This mod turns it into an actual shopping line.

Walk up to the phone in your farmhouse, pick a shop, and a new option appears on the call screen: [b]Order online[/b]. The real shop menu opens — vanilla layout, vanilla stock, vanilla prices plus a clearly marked delivery fee. You pay on the spot. Nothing goes into your backpack. About 15 in-game minutes later (roughly ten seconds of real time), a small gift-box package appears on the farmhouse floor. Walk over, click it once, the contents drop into your inventory and the box disappears.

[b]You are paying for the convenience, not getting free stuff.[/b] Every order carries a 15% delivery fee by default, adjustable between 10% and 20%, and the price shown in the shop menu already includes it — no surprise markup at checkout.

[size=4][b]Shops you can ring[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Pierre[/b] — seeds, saplings, groceries[/*]
[*][b]Robin[/b] — carpenter shop, plus online house-upgrade bookings[/*]
[*][b]Marnie[/b] — animals and ranch supplies[/*]
[*][b]Clint[/b] — blacksmith, plus online tool upgrades and geode cracking[/*]
[*][b]Sandy[/b] — the Oasis, so you can shop the desert without waiting for the bus[/*]
[*][b]Willy[/b] — fish shop[/*]
[*][b]Gus[/b] — the Stardrop Saloon[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Services in detail[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Tool upgrades (Clint)[/b] — pick a tool from your backpack and pay Clint's usual price for that tier, plus the delivery fee. The tool leaves your bag immediately and comes back upgraded as a package. Gold only: Clint sources the bars himself, so you don't need them in your bag.[/*]
[*][b]Geode cracking (Clint)[/b] — hand over every geode in your bag for 25g each plus the fee; the loot arrives later as a package instead of you standing at the anvil.[/*]
[*][b]House upgrades (Robin)[/b] — book the next house upgrade over the phone. It still runs on Robin's normal three-day schedule and still costs the normal gold, wood and hardwood, plus the fee. The mod only saves you the walk to the mountain.[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]DESIGN NOTES[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Vanilla UI only.[/b] It opens the real shop menu and the real dialogue boxes, so it looks like it shipped with the game. Nothing here will fight your retextures.[/*]
[*][b]Nothing is free.[/b] The fee and the waiting time are the entire point — this is a convenience tax, not an easier economy.[/*]
[*][b]Nothing is skipped.[/b] Tools still leave your bag for a while, houses still take Robin's three days, geodes still cost gold. You are only skipping the walk.[/*]
[*][b]You cannot lose an order.[/b] If the farmhouse has no free floor space the package goes by your mailbox; if even that fails the items go straight into your inventory.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b]REQUIREMENTS[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley [b]1.6.15.2[/b][/*]
[*]SMAPI [b]4.3.2[/b] or newer — on Android, use the Android build of SMAPI from [url=https://smapi.io]smapi.io[/url], not the desktop one.[/*]
[*][b]Android[/b] — built and tested against the Android game assemblies. Desktop 1.6 builds may load it, but they are [b]not tested[/b]; please report if you try.[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]INSTALLATION[/b][/size]
Unzip, then place the single folder [b]PhoneOnlineService[/b] (it contains [i]manifest.json[/i] and [i]PhoneOnlineService.dll[/i]) into your Mods folder:

[code]Android/data/com.chucklefish.stardewvalley/files/Mods/ (official APK)
Android/data/<your SMAPI launcher package>/files/Mods/ (SMAPI launcher)[/code]
Launch the game. The SMAPI console should print:
[code][Phone Online Service] Phone online service ready (1.0.4)[/code]
Do not nest the folder twice — the manifest must sit directly inside [i]PhoneOnlineService[/i].

[size=5][b]CONFIGURATION[/b][/size]
Edit [i]config.json[/i] in the mod folder. Changes apply the next time you load a save; no recompile needed.

[list]
[*][b]DeliveryFee[/b] — default [b]0.15[/b]. Delivery fee rate; clamped to 0.10–0.20.[/*]
[*][b]DeliveryTimeMinutes[/b] — default [b]15[/b]. Delivery delay in in-game minutes; clamped to 10–20.[/*]
[*][b]EnableToolUpgrade[/b] — default [b]true[/b]. Allow online tool upgrades.[/*]
[*][b]EnableHouseUpgrade[/b] — default [b]true[/b]. Allow online house upgrades.[/*]
[*][b]EnableGeodeService[/b] — default [b]true[/b]. Allow online geode cracking.[/*]
[*][b]GeodeServiceFee[/b] — default [b]25[/b]. Gold charged per geode.[/*]
[*][b]DebugMode[/b] — default [b]false[/b]. Extra-verbose logging.[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]TROUBLESHOOTING[/b][/size]
Two console commands, typed straight into the SMAPI console:

[list]
[*][b]pos_status[/b] — lists pending orders with minutes remaining, your farmhouse level, player/bed/entry coordinates, and every package inside the house with its tile, contents and whether its position looks valid.[/*]
[*][b]pos_deliver[/b] — settles every pending order immediately. Use this if you paid but never received the goods.[/*]
[/list]
Delivery positions are written to the log at TRACE level by default, for example:
[code]Package delivered: FarmHouse (9,10), 1 item(s) inside.[/code]
If something goes wrong, that line tells you exactly where the box went.

[size=5][b]COMPATIBILITY[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Reads [i]Data/Shops[/i] and [i]Data/Tools[/i] rather than replacing them, so shop-overhaul mods and retextures should be unaffected.[/*]
[*]Uses the official [i]Phone.PhoneHandlers[/i] extension point instead of patching [i]Object.checkForAction[/i], so it is unlikely to clash with other phone mods. Any number another mod already registered is skipped automatically.[/*]
[*]No custom assets at all — nothing to conflict with.[/*]
[*][b]Multiplayer: not tested.[/b] Designed around single-player; each delivery targets the calling player's own farmhouse.[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]LIMITATIONS[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Only the seven shops above are callable. Adding more is a one-line change in [i]ServiceShops.cs[/i] for anyone who wants to fork it.[/*]
[*]Prices are the vanilla prices plus the fee. This mod adds no discounts, no stock overrides and no new items.[/*]
[*]Delivery is intentionally quick in real time — 15 in-game minutes is only about ten seconds. If you want a longer wait, raise [b]DeliveryTimeMinutes[/b].[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]CREDITS[/b][/size]
Built with SMAPI 4.3.2 and Harmony 2.3.3 (the version SMAPI ships with). No third-party code or assets are bundled.

[b]Bug reports:[/b] attach your SMAPI log from [url=https://smapi.io/log]smapi.io/log[/url]. If a delivery never showed up, also paste the output of [b]pos_status[/b] — that is enough to pinpoint it.
